note: Exploratory, outcomes already seen. Corrected for all 3,780 tests, adjusted p = 0.098: not significant.

feature.name: Tumor 5|Macrophage|100um|PD1
feature.definition: per Tumor 5 cell, the mean cohort z-scored PD1 of macrophages within 100 µm; averaged over the patient's Tumor 5 cells

selection_rule: per KM arm, the arm's median patient: sort the arm by (value, patient ID), take index (n - 1) // 2; then that patient's region whose own value is closest to the patient's
pd1_positive_rule: PD1 cohort z-score > 1 (display only; the feature uses the continuous z-score)

km.endpoint: death; days from surgery to last contact
km.cutoff: the cohort median of the feature
